caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular swatch of woven fabric with a pattern of vertical stripes. The fabric features alternating stripes in light blue, beige, tan, and off-white. The stripes vary in width and spacing, running parallel from the top to the bottom of the swatch. Toward the center of the swatch, there is a small, hand-stitched or written code, "J8+," rendered in dark blue. The fabric is positioned against a plain, light beige background, which has some minor spots and discoloration, particularly in the upper left corner. The edges of the fabric are slightly irregular and frayed.
